limitations_mentioned: Analysis relies on summary statistics and not the full raw data, so regression coefficients are approximate.
High collinearity between some predictors inflates uncertainty in individual coefficients; coefficients should be interpreted as representing shared variance rather than unique effects.
Only linear and simple quadratic/interaction forms were tested; more complex nonlinearities could exist but are undetectable with the current data and summary statistics.
Feature selection may be overoptimistic if the sample is not representative of future data.
